subject: A boot log that types itself
one_idea: A fictional machine's boot log types itself one line at a time on an amber-phosphor character grid, then the camera pushes into the grid until a single glyph fills the frame.
facts: Boot log types at 24 glyphs per second; each complete line holds for its readcheck threshold
Minimum readcheck threshold: 1.5 seconds per on-screen text block
Deterministic boot sequence: no Math.random or Date.now used
Amber phosphor with scanlines, curvature, and P3 glow
Character grid zooms from about 80 columns to full-screen detail
